availability.note: Renault AU Scenic E-Tech page lists techno, techno - Long Range and esprit Alpine with build & price links (price shown POA); CarsGuide lists the same three for MY2026/2027

listPrice.note: Renault AU press release lists all three grades 'plus on-road costs' (manufacturer's own price, preferred per owner convention); CarsGuide model page re-checked 2026-11-27 lists $55,990-$65,990 'all before on-road costs' for MY2026/2027; CarExpert quick drive table 'before on-roads' agrees. renault.com.au vehicle page now shows POA and the build & price tool is script-rendered, so no live configurator price was read. Cross-check: CarExpert Sydney drive-away $60,907 (Techno) / $71,407 (Esprit Alpine) differ by $10,500 vs list $10,000, consistent with NSW 5% marginal duty on unchanged list prices.

batteryKwh.note: usable 60.0 kWh; gross (nominal) 65.0 kWh on the same page; Renault AU quotes 60kWh

rangeKm.note: Renault AU vehicle page '430km WLTP' for techno EV60; EV Database TU2025 WLTP 430 km (TEL) / 418 km (TEH); AU Techno ships on 19-inch wheels (CarExpert), matching the low-end figure

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: CarExpert quick drive claimed 16.3kWh/100km; EV Database WLTP rated 163 Wh/km (TEL). WLTP rated consumption includes charging losses, hence ~16% above usable/range

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Renault AU '545 litres'; ADAC labels 545 L 'normal' (to the cover); no frunk

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Renault AU '1,670 litres with the rear bench folded'; ADAC labels 1,670 L 'dachhoch' (to the roof), not the belt-line convention. No belt-line figure found (kofferraum.org refused). Kept maker figure, as bmw-ix1 / alfa-romeo-tonale-phev do; overstates vs convention

towKg.note: CarExpert quick drive spec table 1,100kg braked all grades; CarExpert 2026 model page and EV Database agree. No Renault AU tech sheet found

warrantyYears.note: Renault AU page: 5 years/100,000km vehicle warranty, battery 8 years/160,000km (70%). CarExpert and Chasing Cars say unlimited km; term is 5 either way

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; level with skoda-elroq-85-select (1750 at $55,990, same price)

depreciationCurve.note: One curve per Renault brand. Owner asked to match renault-megane-e-tech, but that family was removed 2026-11-26 and no file holds its curve (archive records only its year-one 0.68). Scenic is now the only Renault family, so all three rows take the held Techno curve; Esprit Alpine moved from its held steeper [1,0.7,...]. Below mainstream default for thin local volume (CarExpert: 127 sales 2026 YTD), small Ateco-distributed brand and the Megane's $10,000 cut
